name: 02 Broadsheet
description: The approved Broadsheet look as a Liftkit concept: Source Serif 4 throughout, paper-grey ground, cyan accent, 1 to 4px radii, 7/5 asymmetric splits, whitespace instead of dividers, the thick-thin double rule and dateline stat rail, tag chips, video hero, alternating split service rows, icon index, italic pull quote, photo CTA card, four-column footer. Extended in the same language to every module and template of the full site. Three tier territories (teal, sage, gold) change only thin rules, eyebrows, tags, active nav and section tints.

notes.tone b: the system's neutral-100 band, or the territory tint on tier pages (inside the 1200px column, as in the original)
notes.territory: body/wrapper class terr-teal | terr-sage | terr-gold sets --terr (thin rules), --terr-ink (eyebrows, small text), --terr-tint (bands). Brand blue is never replaced.
